objective: smallest tested configuration passing quality, access, latency and resource gates separately in leave.ru, leave.kk, advance.ru, advance.kk

stages.precision: one verified common dtype if possible

stages.change: winner weight quantization: int8 and int4 if supported; compare to stage A
winner context budget: 1024 and 3072; compare to 2048
stages.restriction: reject or explicitly abstain when complete supporting rule cannot fit; never cut exceptions

stages.change: optional original versus SFT under identical evidence and budgets; same final serving format
provisional winner and baseline on frozen verification set, concurrency 1; optional concurrency 4 stress run separate
stages.restriction: do not tune on verification failures while calling that set untouched

stochastic_followup: only if sampling is required: 3 recorded seeds, keep all repeats clustered by case/family
claims_allowed: minimum among actually tested configurations, not a universal minimum
